subject: Downtown Silver Spring Caribbean restaurant Negril Jamaican Eatery has announced the passing of longtime employee Jose “Luis” Flores.
posts:
True community leadership isn't found in office, but in the daily service of a local anchor. 

Negril Honors Luis Flores, the Unofficial Mayor of Downtown Silver Spring
Evidence: community service, human connection, lasting legacy
#Community #SilverSpring

The claim is that Luis Flores was a pillar of his community, providing warmth and service that defined the local atmosphere.

The passing of Jose “Luis” Flores, a beloved employee at Negril Jamaican Eatery, has left a void in the Silver Spring community he served for years.

The loss of such a central figure reminds us of the fragility of the social bonds that hold our local communities together.
